origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 掩 par « resserrer, recouvrir » : 扌, la main, et 奄 pour le son. 奄, écrit 大 sur 电, se lit yǎn, exactement comme 掩. La main qui couvre et dérobe aux regards : cacher, comme dans 掩盖.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 掩 as “to draw in, to cover”: 扌, hand, and 奄 for the sound. 奄, written 大 over 电, is read yǎn, exactly like 掩. A hand that covers and hides from view: to conceal, as in 掩盖.

phrase.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yǎngài zìjǐ de cuòwù.
phrase.en: He wants to cover up his mistake.
